name: Julie Ann Bookman
office: Eastside Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Julie Ann Bookman is the board president of the Eastside Union School District Governing Board and represents Trustee Area 5. Her term runs from December 2022 through December 2026. She earned a bachelor's degree in agronomy from Cal Poly Pomona and a master's degree in education from Chapman University. In July 2026 she supported appointing Dr. Tinisha Hamberlin as superintendent, saying the district should strengthen instruction and invest in staff to prepare students for high school.
